name: Wizard OS 0.3.68 — current Agent Service and Wizard UX, exact AI account matching
about: 0.3.67 (backup plus the current Stable fixes) with the Agent Service and Wizard UX moved to current main. Setup says a phone is connected only after it opens Wizard; Claude and ChatGPT accounts report a one-way email hash, so the Claude app shows the same account once and never merges two different ones; Home names a ChatGPT sign-in 'ChatGPT' instead of 'openai-codex-oauth-1'; the model picker refetches on open and says when the Claude app is not answering instead of hiding Claude silently. Claude 0.2.8 and ChatGPT 0.2.6 carry the new accounts page (design rules v0).

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.
